entries.name: Upper Mottled Terrain
entries.description: Mottled terrain covers much of this end of the nucleus. It may be older surface material altered by sublimation.
entries.qualification: Approximate location from Deep Space 1’s published terrain map.

reference.title: The morphology and surface processes of Comet 19/P Borrelly

entries.name: Central Mesas
entries.description: Flat-topped mesas rise above the surrounding smooth terrain. Their slopes may expose volatile-rich material.
entries.qualification: Approximate location from Deep Space 1’s published terrain map.

reference.title: The morphology and surface processes of Comet 19/P Borrelly

entries.name: Central Smooth Terrain
entries.description: Smooth terrain lies below the central mesas and may collect debris falling from them.
entries.qualification: Approximate location from Deep Space 1’s published terrain map.

reference.title: The morphology and surface processes of Comet 19/P Borrelly

entries.name: Lower Mottled Terrain
entries.description: Mottled terrain covers much of the smaller lobe. Sublimation and collapse may have helped produce its rough texture.
entries.qualification: Approximate location from Deep Space 1’s published terrain map.
